skills.title: Brainstorm options
skills.description: Generate distinct options for a decision, assess their tradeoffs candidly, and recommend a short ranked set without forcing a final choice.

skills.title: Pressure-test an idea
skills.description: Find weak points in a leading strategic idea before commitment by testing its strongest case, critical assumptions, dissent, failure modes, and falsifiable evidence.

skills.title: Make a decision
skills.description: Match decision-making rigor to stakes and reversibility, make clear calls, preserve authorized records, and review outcomes without inventing the user’s views.

skills.title: Solve a problem
skills.description: Take a non-trivial product, technical, process, or automation problem from diagnosis through recommendation, implementation, verification, and handoff.

skills.title: Shape and draft a document
skills.description: Shape consequential documents through evidence review, answer-dependent alignment rounds, readiness checks, drafting, and delivery audit.

skills.title: Gather context
skills.description: Search the sources that are likely to matter and turn the findings into one concise, well-sourced brief.

skills.title: Learn with a tutor
skills.description: Learn a paper, article, or topic through a rigorous Socratic dialogue built on retrieval, explanation, and practical application rather than passive summary.

skills.title: Write in my voice
skills.description: Draft or revise email in the user’s established voice, verify facts and commitments, and optionally create one reviewable draft in the user’s chosen email system.

skills.title: Write a professional social post
skills.description: Draft, revise, and audit professional social posts that lead with concrete value, fit a defined audience, and remain accurate, defensible, and easy to scan.

skills.title: Write a case study post
skills.description: Create an evidence-based case study post with strong hooks, a review-ready draft, quote-card options, approvals, and a publishing checklist.

skills.title: Create editorial cover images
skills.description: Create and review eight article-specific cover-image options through five initial concepts and three evidence-based improvements.

skills.title: Plan your day
skills.description: Choose one most important outcome, protect time for it, and make a realistic plan around existing commitments.

skills.title: Review your day
skills.description: Run a short end-of-day reflection on what happened, what mattered, and what should change tomorrow.

skills.title: Plan your week
skills.description: Review the previous week, choose a few outcomes, cut lower-value work, and protect time for what matters.

skills.title: Review and plan a month
skills.description: Close one month honestly, then create a small, capacity-checked, explicitly approved plan for the next month using evidence, trade-offs, and concrete commitments.

skills.title: Get unstuck
skills.description: Work out why you are stuck, then use a short intervention suited to tiredness, dread, confusion, or distraction.

skills.title: Wind down for sleep
skills.description: A quiet, interactive evening workflow that reduces stimulation, secures distractions, prepares essential morning needs offline, and provides a brief stimulus-control response when sleep does not come.

skills.title: Plan and book a trip
skills.description: Plan a trip around its purpose, compare complete journeys and current fares, and prepare or complete a booking within the user's authorization.

skills.title: Prepare for a meeting
skills.description: Research the right context, clarify the user’s intended outcome, and produce a focused, access-appropriate meeting brief and agenda.

skills.title: Capture meeting actions
skills.description: Review authorized meeting records, capture genuine unfinished commitments as clear deduplicated tasks, and batch only the judgment calls that need clarification.

skills.title: Turn a message into a task
skills.description: Turn a message thread into researched, pre-completed work, and create a clear task record only when tracking will help.

skills.title: Process an inbox to zero
skills.description: A privacy-aware workflow for converting authorized email and message inboxes into clear next actions without confusing triage with planning or deep work.

skills.title: Design a work sample
skills.description: Create or improve a short, paid, asynchronous work sample that produces job-relevant evidence and can be scored consistently. Validate that it distinguishes role-relevant performance through simulated submissions.

skills.title: Run a reference call
skills.description: Prepare and run a concise reference conversation that gathers specific evidence instead of vague praise.

skills.title: Use a browser safely
skills.description: Complete browser-based tasks safely by choosing the least invasive route, protecting authenticated context, verifying rendered state, and separating preparation from consequential actions.

skills.title: Create an AI skill
skills.description: Design, test, improve, evaluate, and package reusable AI skills through an evidence-based, user-centered workflow.

skills.title: Test every screen size
skills.description: Verify every UI and CSS change across representative screen sizes, realistic content, screenshots, and layout checks before completion.

skills.title: Run a recurring community event
skills.description: Create, publish, verify, and invite the approved audience to authorized recurring community events using adaptable tools, privacy-aware controls, and readiness checks.
